final: SELECT c.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS invoiced_order_count, 1.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) / SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id)) OVER () AS share_of_total, 1.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) / SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id)) OVER () - AVG(1.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) / SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id)) OVER ()) OVER () AS above_average_share FROM Customers c JOIN Orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN Invoices i ON i.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY c.gender HAVING 1.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) / SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id)) OVER () > AVG(1.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) / SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id)) OVER ()) OVER ()
